objectives.objective_text: લેખક વિનોદ ભટ્ટના હાસ્યસાહિત્યના પ્રદાનની અને 'સૂરજ તો બધે જ સરખો' નિબંધમાં ખાણી-પીણી-ઘેલા પ્રવાસીની ટેવ પરના કટાક્ષની ઓળખ કરવી.
સર્વજ્ઞભાઈ તાજમહેલમાં અંદર જઈને ક્યારેય જોયો જ નથી છતાં દાળવડાંનાં વખાણ કરે છે અને તાજને 'એક કબર' ગણાવે છે એમાં રહેલો કટાક્ષ સમજાવવો.
માથેરાનમાં પુરોહિતવાળી હોટલનાં દાળભાત અને પેનોરમા પોઈન્ટ પરના નારિયેળ-પાણી સિવાય સર્વજ્ઞભાઈને બીજું કંઈ યાદ નથી રહેતું એ પરથી તેમની પ્રવાસ-ટેવ તારવવી.
દાર્જિલિંગના ઝરણામાં પગ બોળવાને બદલે દહીંવડાં ખાવાનું પસંદ કરતા સર્વજ્ઞભાઈ કશ્મીર વિશે જે બેપરવા ટીકા કરે છે તેમાં રહેલો કટાક્ષ પારખવો.
મહાબળેશ્વરના સૂર્યોદય કરતાં ઊંઘ વધારે વહાલી ગણી 'સૂરજ તો બધે જ સરખો' કહેતા સર્વજ્ઞભાઈ સસ્તા આબુમાં જ અમદાવાદીઓ ભટકાવાની ફરિયાદ કેમ કરે છે તે તારવવું.
છેલ્લે ક્યાંય પ્રવાસ ન કરવાનું નક્કી કરી ધાબા પર આઈસ્ક્રીમ ખાવાની મજાને 'પૃથ્વીનો છેડો ઘર' કહેતા સર્વજ્ઞભાઈના શબ્દોમાં લેખકનો કટાક્ષ કઈ રીતે પૂરો થાય છે તે કહેવું.

notes: Cut rationale: nibandh_atmaparak.md's unit is 'એક પ્રસંગ, અથવા વિચારનો એક વળાંક', boundary at the writer's own turn. Agent 1 already marked the boundary on the rendered page with one [[લેખક-પરિચય]] marker plus five [[ઘટના: ...]] markers (01_meta.json's structure_inventory.ghatna: 5). Six markers map to exactly six topics here — no marker silently swallowed, no topic invented where no marker sits, per agents/02_structure.md's Agent-4 check.

[[લેખક-પરિચય]] covers both the author-bio paragraph AND the unmarked કૃતિ-પરિચય paragraph that immediately follows it with no marker of its own (00_chapter_normalized.md lines 3-10): this matches profiles/students/std-10.md §1.4's measured finding that std-10 chapters open with an unlabeled bio + કૃતિ-પરિચય pair separated only by a rule, and agents/02_structure.md's own instruction that this pair is ONE CONCEPT topic (singular), not two. Folded into M1.S1.T1.

Two of the five printed [[ઘટના: ...]] markers each name two places and run two question-answer exchanges on the page. For M2.S2.T4 (Darjeeling+Kashmir) the Kashmir line is a one-clause coda to the same running joke (food over the ઝરણું) — the ભાવ never actually moves to a new subject, so it stays ONE concept. For M2.S2.T5 (Mahabaleshwar+Abu) the ભાવ genuinely moves — from 'enjoy મહાબળેશ્વર cheaply via a travel package, skip the sunrise' (carrying the chapter's own title line) to 'go to cheaper આબુ instead', which then backfires into the very complaint that seeds the closing topic — so M2.S2.T5 gets two concepts (C5, C6), never a third, per the profile's 'litany inside one movement' test. Both stay ONE topic each either way, honouring 'one marker, one topic'.
topic_type: CONCEPT for the opener; STORY_TELLING for all five ઘટના topics, each holding a narrated પ્રસંગ — the authored-enum value explanation_unit_map.md assigns to 'a narrative ઘટના'.

No topic carries topic_category: 'climax' — nibandh_atmaparak.md's hard gate #2 forbids it for this genre ('these chapters have પ્રસંગ, not પ્લોટ'). M2.S2.T5, which carries the chapter's title-line and its densest content, is marked 'transition': it is the hinge between the string of far-off destinations and the final decision to stay home, not a plot peak. M2.S3.T6 is 'resolution' per the profile's explicit instruction for the closing gesture; T2-T4 are 'core', T1 is 'introduction'.

Third-person caveat, carried forward from 01_meta.json's own extraction_notes: this chapter's original_chunk will carry NO first-person 'હું' anywhere — both voices are unlabeled, and the humour is built entirely from the caricature 'સર્વજ્ઞભાઈ''s own words, framed from outside by the printed intro's third-person 'લેખક કટાક્ષ કરે છે'. No objective_text or topic_name here attributes a self-deprecating admission to a first-person narrator — the same shape nibandh_atmaparak.md documents for std-7 ch6, held for its unit and its gate only. Agents 5/12 must not invent a 'હું' confession this chapter does not carry.

Difficulty set per agents/02_structure.md's std 9-10 row ('a સંવાદ carrying the argument's turn'): the whole chapter is unattributed two-voice dialogue with no 'કહ્યું' tags. M2.S2.T4 and M2.S2.T5 are 'hard' — both run the longest unattributed exchanges and both carry a pun-or-idiom-dependent punchline (the 'ગરમી પડે છે' double meaning on કશ્મીર; the title-line plus a second location-switch inside one speech turn) that a literal reading misses. M1.S1.T1 is 'easy' (one expository paragraph, no dialogue). M2.S2.T2 is 'medium' — the joke pattern's first appearance. M2.S2.T3 drops to 'easy' — the pattern is already learned by this point and this is its shortest, plainest repeat. M2.S3.T6 is 'medium' — shorter than T4/T5 but needs the whole essay held in mind to read 'પૃથ્વીનો છેડો ઘર' as the punchline.

depends_on: only M2.S3.T6 carries a real dependency, on M2.S2.T5 — the decision to stay in Ahmedabad answers directly the twist that closes T5 (meeting fellow અમદાવાદીઓ in આબુ). Every other topic is an independently self-contained iteration of the same repetition-with-escalation joke (a new place, the same food-over-sightseeing habit), so their depends_on stays [].

No અલંકાર, છંદ, or સાહિત્યપ્રકાર label appears in any objective_text, topic_name, module_name or segment_name. 'કટાક્ષ'/'વ્યંગ' are used freely as tone-words because 01_meta.json's own ભાષા-અભિવ્યક્તિ record never applies a formal device-name to this chapter either — the craft-naming gate (profiles/students/std-10.md §1.4) targets formal અલંકાર/છंद labels, not this genre's own vocabulary for its tone.

Apparatus and exercise exclusion: the શબ્દ-સમજૂતી box (સમાનાર્થી/શબ્દાર્થ, તળપદા શબ્દો, વિરુદ્ધાર્થી), the single કહેવત block, all four સ્વાધ્યાય tiers, વિદ્યાર્થી-પ્રવૃત્તિ, ભાષા-અભિવ્યક્તિ and શિક્ષકની ભૂમિકા are apparatus/exercise territory already recorded in 01_meta.json's exercise_inventory and extraction_notes — none of it is cut as a topic here, per global_content_rules.md #7 and explanation_unit_map.md's apparatus rule.

Sensitivity flag for Agent 8/12, not a structural decision: M2.S2.T4's original_chunk will carry સર્વજ્ઞભાઈ's line about કश्मीर and આતંકવાદીઓ — a callous pun on ગરમ. The topic is cut here because that is where the printed page puts the line; downstream agents must keep it verbatim, name it as કટાક્ષ once, and never extend or normalise the remark (nibandh_atmaparak.md's humour-sensitivity rule; global_content_rules.md #10).
original_chunk is left empty in every topic per this agent's mandate — Agent 5 fills it from the rendered pages, not this file.

Bloom spread across the six objectives (Understand x2, Analyze x3, Evaluate x1) climbs toward Evaluate at the closing topic, matching std-10's evaluation/transfer emphasis (profiles/students/std-10.md §1.3) without capping any topic's later recall ladder — that ceiling is Agent 12's job, not this file's.
